title: Nexus Analytics Dashboard
description: A ready-to-run YouTube downloader packaged as a ZIP. Unzip, install dependencies, and pull videos quickly.
longDescription: Nexus Analytics is an enterprise-grade web application offering real-time data visualization, customizable dashboards, and automated performance reporting. Built with React and Node.js microservices for maximum speed.

title: Physics With Anurag
description: Official website for physics notes and resources. Designed for fast access and clean UI.
longDescription: Physics With Anurag is a dedicated educational platform providing comprehensive physics notes, interactive problem-solving tools, and resource links for students. The website is optimized for speed and user experience.

title: Cluter Handler
description: Fix you dirty random files in a folder.
longDescription: Cluter Handler is a simple yet effective tool for organizing and cleaning up random files in a folder. It provides a user-friendly interface to identify, sort, and remove unwanted files efficiently.
